In order to wear the body, a player must first have completed the [[Dragon Slayer I]] quest and have level 40 [[Ranged]] and [[Defence]]. It offers the best ranged accuracy bonus among all [[free-to-play]] body armours, although its defensive bonuses are surpassed by the [[gilded d'hide body]]. Although players must complete Dragon Slayer I in order to wear a green d'hide body, completion of this quest is ''not'' required to equip [[Blue d'hide body|blue]], [[Red d'hide body|red]], and
